frozen.note: The check arm's frozen judge (eval/turnwatch-frozen.json: the same prompt, model, thresholds and first-words window), anchored at the main session's first tool call of any kind after a delivered user message (research/eval/turn_anchor.py). When that tool call is check_state the row is the check arm's row. Otherwise GOAL and NOTE come from the first check_state within the first-words window after the tool call, if there is one. REACH on the realdrift DEV set is measured by turn_anchor.py --reach (DEV_NOT_HELD_OUT: one session, labels known in advance). This arm has NOT been scored: it claims no catches, and its rows are watch-only.
